def upload(self, actor_id: str, filename: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("upload", lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"filename":filename,"size":len(content)}}) as operation:
            if len(content) > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise BusinessError("file_too_large", 413)
            name = self.monitor.transform("db_transform", clean_filename, filename, before=lambda value:{"filename":value}, after=lambda value:{"filename":value})
            identifier = uuid.uuid4().hex
            path = self.store.blobs / identifier
            row = {"id":identifier,"owner_id":actor_id,"filename":name,"size":len(content),"created_at":timestamp()}
            try:
                with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                    self._authorize(connection, actor_id, "upload")
                    path.write_bytes(content)
                    self.store.write(connection, insert(files).values(**row))
            except BaseException:
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise
            operation.record("commit", lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identifier,"saved":True,"size":len(content)}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identifier,"saved":True,"size":len(content)}})
            return row

def request_share(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str, reviewer_id: str) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("share", lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id,"reviewer_id":reviewer_id}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file = self._one(connection, files, file_id)
                self._authorize(connection, actor_id, "share", file=file)
                self._one(connection, users, recipient_id)
                self._one(connection, users, reviewer_id)
                if recipient_id == actor_id:
                    raise BusinessError("recipient_must_differ", 400)
                existing = self.store.read(connection, select(shares.c.id).where(and_(shares.c.file_id == file_id,shares.c.recipient_id == recipient_id,shares.c.state.in_(["pending","approved"]))))
                if existing:
                    raise BusinessError("share_already_active", 409)
                row={"id":uuid.uuid4().hex,"file_id":file_id,"owner_id":actor_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id,"reviewer_id":reviewer_id,"state":self.machine["initial"],"revision":1,"created_at":timestamp()}
                self.store.write(connection, insert(shares).values(**row))
                self._journal(connection,row,"submit",row["state"],{"authorized":True})
            self.monitor.state("share",row,{"event":None,"guards":{},"payload":{}},initial=True)
            operation.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":{"share_id":row["id"],"state":row["state"],"revision":1}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"share_id":row["id"],"state":row["state"],"revision":1}})
            return row

def change_share(self, actor_id: str, share_id: str, event: str) -> dict:
        node = "review" if event in {"approve","reject"} else "cancel_share" if event == "cancel" else "revoke"
        policy_operation = "review" if node == "review" else node
        with self.monitor.span(node,lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"share_id":share_id,"event":event}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                row=self._one(connection,shares,share_id)
                self._authorize(connection,actor_id,policy_operation,share=row)
                context={key:row[key] for key in self.machine["context"]}
                try:
                    result=SharingWorkflow(self.machine,True).advance(row["state"],event,context)
                except ValueError:
                    raise BusinessError("invalid_transition",409) from None
                before=row["state"]
                row.update(state=result["state"],revision=row["revision"]+1)
                self.store.write(connection,update(shares).where(shares.c.id==share_id).values(state=row["state"],revision=row["revision"]))
                self._journal(connection,row,event,before,result["guards"])
                if event in {"approve","reject"}:
                    file=self._one(connection,files,row["file_id"])
                    self._messages(connection,row,file,"review_result")
                    if event == "approve":
                        self._messages(connection,row,file,"shared")
            self.monitor.state(node,row,result)
            operation.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":{"state":row["state"],"revision":row["revision"],"changed":True}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"state":row["state"],"revision":row["revision"],"changed":True}})
            return row

"""Authenticated file sharing, selected review and revocable downloads."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import uuid

from sqlalchemy import select, insert, update, and_
from werkzeug.security import check_password_hash
from app.models import users, files, shares, notifications, journal
from app.policy import authorize
from app.storage import timestamp
from bo_stategraph.workflow import SharingWorkflow


class BusinessError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, code, status=403):
        self.code, self.status = code, status
        super().__init__(code)


def clean_filename(value: str) -> str:
    name = value.replace("\\", "/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1].strip()
    if not name or len(name) > 180 or any(ord(char) < 32 for char in name):
        raise BusinessError("invalid_filename", 400)
    return name


class Service:
    def __init__(self, store, project, root):
        self.store, self.project, self.root = store, project, Path(root)
        self.monitor = store.monitor
        self.machine = project["model"]["machine"]
        self.policy = project["model"]["policy"]

    def _one(self, connection, table, identifier):
        rows = self.store.read(connection, select(table).where(table.c.id == identifier))
        if not rows:
            raise BusinessError("not_found", 404)
        return rows[0]

    def _facts(self, connection, actor_id, file=None, share=None):
        authenticated = bool(actor_id) and bool(self.store.read(connection, select(users.c.id).where(users.c.id == actor_id)))
        owner_id = file["owner_id"] if file else share["owner_id"] if share else ""
        granted = bool(file and actor_id == owner_id)
        if file and not granted:
            granted = bool(self.store.read(connection, select(shares.c.id).where(and_(shares.c.file_id == file["id"],shares.c.recipient_id == actor_id,shares.c.state == "approved"))))
        return {"signed_in":authenticated,"actor_is_owner":bool(owner_id and actor_id == owner_id),"download_granted":granted,"actor_is_selected_reviewer":bool(share and actor_id == share["reviewer_id"]),"share_is_pending":bool(share and share["state"] == "pending"),"share_is_approved":bool(share and share["state"] == "approved")}

    def _evaluate(self, connection, actor_id, operation, file=None, share=None):
        facts = self._facts(connection, actor_id, file, share)
        entity = share["id"] if share else file["id"] if file else "application"
        evaluation = authorize(self.policy, operation, facts, entity + ":" + str(share["revision"] if share else uuid.uuid4().hex), self.root)
        self.monitor.policy(self.policy, evaluation, entity, entity)
        return evaluation, facts

    def _authorize(self, connection, actor_id, operation, file=None, share=None):
        evaluation, facts = self._evaluate(connection, actor_id, operation, file, share)
        if evaluation["value"] is not True:
            raise BusinessError("permission_denied", 403 if facts["signed_in"] else 401)
        return evaluation

    def login(self, username: str, password: str) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("login", lambda:{"inputs":{"username":username,"password_supplied":bool(password)}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                rows = self.store.read(connection, select(users).where(users.c.id == username))
                allowed = bool(rows) and check_password_hash(rows[0]["password_hash"], password)
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"allowed":allowed,"user_id":username if allowed else ""}})
            operation.record("decision",lambda:{"outputs":{"allowed":allowed,"user_id":username if allowed else ""}})
            if not allowed:
                raise BusinessError("invalid_login", 401)
            return {"id":rows[0]["id"],"name":rows[0]["name"]}

    def logout(self, actor_id: str) -> None:
        with self.monitor.span("logout", lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id}}) as operation:
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"logged_out":True}})

    def upload(self, actor_id: str, filename: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("upload", lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"filename":filename,"size":len(content)}}) as operation:
            if len(content) > 20 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise BusinessError("file_too_large", 413)
            name = self.monitor.transform("db_transform", clean_filename, filename, before=lambda value:{"filename":value}, after=lambda value:{"filename":value})
            identifier = uuid.uuid4().hex
            path = self.store.blobs / identifier
            row = {"id":identifier,"owner_id":actor_id,"filename":name,"size":len(content),"created_at":timestamp()}
            try:
                with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                    self._authorize(connection, actor_id, "upload")
                    path.write_bytes(content)
                    self.store.write(connection, insert(files).values(**row))
            except BaseException:
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                raise
            operation.record("commit", lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identifier,"saved":True,"size":len(content)}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"file_id":identifier,"saved":True,"size":len(content)}})
            return row

    def request_share(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str, recipient_id: str, reviewer_id: str) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("share", lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"file_id":file_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id,"reviewer_id":reviewer_id}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file = self._one(connection, files, file_id)
                self._authorize(connection, actor_id, "share", file=file)
                self._one(connection, users, recipient_id)
                self._one(connection, users, reviewer_id)
                if recipient_id == actor_id:
                    raise BusinessError("recipient_must_differ", 400)
                existing = self.store.read(connection, select(shares.c.id).where(and_(shares.c.file_id == file_id,shares.c.recipient_id == recipient_id,shares.c.state.in_(["pending","approved"]))))
                if existing:
                    raise BusinessError("share_already_active", 409)
                row={"id":uuid.uuid4().hex,"file_id":file_id,"owner_id":actor_id,"recipient_id":recipient_id,"reviewer_id":reviewer_id,"state":self.machine["initial"],"revision":1,"created_at":timestamp()}
                self.store.write(connection, insert(shares).values(**row))
                self._journal(connection,row,"submit",row["state"],{"authorized":True})
            self.monitor.state("share",row,{"event":None,"guards":{},"payload":{}},initial=True)
            operation.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":{"share_id":row["id"],"state":row["state"],"revision":1}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"share_id":row["id"],"state":row["state"],"revision":1}})
            return row

    def _journal(self, connection, row, event, before, guards):
        self.store.write(connection, insert(journal).values(id=uuid.uuid4().hex,share_id=row["id"],revision=row["revision"],event=event,before_state=before,after_state=row["state"],guards=json.dumps(guards),created_at=timestamp()))

    def _messages(self, connection, row, file, kind):
        recipients = sorted({row["owner_id"],row["recipient_id"],row["reviewer_id"]})
        with self.monitor.span("notification" if kind == "review_result" else "share_message", lambda:{"inputs":{"share_id":row["id"],"kind":kind,"recipients":recipients}}) as operation:
            for recipient in recipients:
                self.store.write(connection, insert(notifications).values(id=uuid.uuid4().hex,user_id=recipient,share_id=row["id"],kind=kind,state=row["state"],filename=file["filename"],is_read=0,created_at=timestamp()))
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"count":len(recipients),"state":row["state"]}})

    def change_share(self, actor_id: str, share_id: str, event: str) -> dict:
        node = "review" if event in {"approve","reject"} else "cancel_share" if event == "cancel" else "revoke"
        policy_operation = "review" if node == "review" else node
        with self.monitor.span(node,lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"share_id":share_id,"event":event}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                row=self._one(connection,shares,share_id)
                self._authorize(connection,actor_id,policy_operation,share=row)
                context={key:row[key] for key in self.machine["context"]}
                try:
                    result=SharingWorkflow(self.machine,True).advance(row["state"],event,context)
                except ValueError:
                    raise BusinessError("invalid_transition",409) from None
                before=row["state"]
                row.update(state=result["state"],revision=row["revision"]+1)
                self.store.write(connection,update(shares).where(shares.c.id==share_id).values(state=row["state"],revision=row["revision"]))
                self._journal(connection,row,event,before,result["guards"])
                if event in {"approve","reject"}:
                    file=self._one(connection,files,row["file_id"])
                    self._messages(connection,row,file,"review_result")
                    if event == "approve":
                        self._messages(connection,row,file,"shared")
            self.monitor.state(node,row,result)
            operation.record("commit",lambda:{"outputs":{"state":row["state"],"revision":row["revision"],"changed":True}})
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"state":row["state"],"revision":row["revision"],"changed":True}})
            return row

    def download(self, actor_id: str, file_id: str) -> tuple:
        with self.monitor.operation("download","return",lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"file_id":file_id}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                file=self._one(connection,files,file_id)
                self._authorize(connection,actor_id,"download",file=file)
                content=(self.store.blobs/file_id).read_bytes()
            operation.result(lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"file_id":file_id},"outputs":{"allowed":True,"size":len(content),"file_id":file_id}})
            return file["filename"],content

    def dashboard(self, actor_id: str) -> dict:
        with self.monitor.span("received_files",lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                self._authorize(connection,actor_id,"upload")
                members=self.store.read(connection,select(users.c.id,users.c.name))
                owned=self.store.read(connection,select(files).where(files.c.owner_id==actor_id).order_by(files.c.created_at.desc()))
                candidates=self.store.read(connection,select(files,shares.c.id.label("share_id"),shares.c.owner_id.label("sharer_id")).join(shares,files.c.id==shares.c.file_id).where(shares.c.recipient_id==actor_id))
                received=[]
                for candidate in candidates:
                    evaluation, _ = self._evaluate(connection,actor_id,"received_files",file=candidate)
                    if evaluation["value"] is True and candidate["id"] not in {item["id"] for item in received}:
                        received.append(candidate)
                outgoing=self.store.read(connection,select(shares,files.c.filename).join(files,shares.c.file_id==files.c.id).where(shares.c.owner_id==actor_id).order_by(shares.c.created_at.desc()))
                reviews=self.store.read(connection,select(shares,files.c.filename).join(files,shares.c.file_id==files.c.id).where(and_(shares.c.reviewer_id==actor_id,shares.c.state=="pending")))
                messages=self.store.read(connection,select(notifications).where(notifications.c.user_id==actor_id).order_by(notifications.c.created_at.desc()))
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"owned_count":len(owned),"received_count":len(received),"review_count":len(reviews),"message_count":len(messages)}})
            return {"members":members,"owned":owned,"received":received,"outgoing":outgoing,"reviews":reviews,"messages":messages}

    def read_notification(self, actor_id: str, notification_id: str) -> None:
        with self.monitor.span("read_notification",lambda:{"inputs":{"actor_id":actor_id,"notification_id":notification_id}}) as operation:
            with self.store.transaction() as connection:
                message=self._one(connection,notifications,notification_id)
                if message["user_id"] != actor_id:
                    raise BusinessError("permission_denied")
                self.store.write(connection,update(notifications).where(notifications.c.id==notification_id).values(is_read=1))
            operation.result(lambda:{"outputs":{"is_read":True}})

"""Check the supplied callable against the current source without importing it."""

import hashlib
import inspect
import marshal
from pathlib import Path
from types import CodeType


def code_signature(code):
    """Ignore line offsets, retaining executable bytecode, constants and names."""
    return (
        code.co_code,
        tuple(code_signature(c) if isinstance(c, CodeType) else c for c in code.co_consts),
        code.co_names,
        code.co_varnames,
        code.co_freevars,
        code.co_cellvars,
        code.co_argcount,
        code.co_posonlyargcount,
        code.co_kwonlyargcount,
        code.co_flags,
    )


def callable_binding(callback, source, root):
    """Reject stale loaded functions even when the file on disk was updated."""
    actual = inspect.unwrap(callback)
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path = (root / source["path"]).resolve()
    actual_path = inspect.getsourcefile(actual)
    symbol = getattr(actual, "__qualname__", "").replace(".<locals>.", ".")
    if (
        not path.is_relative_to(root)
        or actual_path is None
        or Path(actual_path).resolve() != path
        or symbol != source["symbol"]
        or not hasattr(actual, "__code__")
    ):
        raise ValueError("native predicate source differs: " + source["symbol"])
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    compiled = compile(raw, str(path), "exec", dont_inherit=True)
    candidates = []

    def walk(code):
        if code.co_qualname.replace(".<locals>.", ".") == symbol:
            candidates.append(code)
        for value in code.co_consts:
            if isinstance(value, CodeType):
                walk(value)

    walk(compiled)
    if len(candidates) != 1 or code_signature(candidates[0]) != code_signature(actual.__code__):
        raise ValueError("loaded policy function differs from current source: " + symbol)
    return {
        **source,
        "file_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        "code_sha256": hashlib.sha256(marshal.dumps(code_signature(actual.__code__))).hexdigest(),
    }

"""Independent business, HTTP, transaction and declaration tests using synthetic data."""

from copy import deepcopy
from contextlib import closing
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/"observer_runtime")]

from app.storage import Store
from app.service import Service,BusinessError
from app.web import create_app
from bo_stategraph import BOStateGraph
from bo_stategraph.native_executor import BOExecutor
from bo_observer.data.catalog import collect,export_sqlalchemy_metadata
from bo_observer.data.schema_compare import structure_differences
from app.models import metadata


class SharingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="unittest-",dir=ROOT/"review")
        self.project=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.store=Store(self.temp.name)
        self.store.initialize()
        self.service=Service(self.store,self.project,ROOT)
        self.file=self.service.upload("owner","notes.txt",b"Private synthetic content")
        self.share=self.service.request_share("owner",self.file["id"],"recipient","reviewer")

    def tearDown(self):
        self.store.engine.dispose()
        self.assertTrue(Path(self.temp.name).resolve().is_relative_to((ROOT/"review").resolve()))
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def state(self):
        return self.store.snapshot("test")["instances"][0]["state"]

    def test_login_and_bad_password(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.service.login("owner","TrialOnly!2026")["id"],"owner")
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.login("owner","incorrect")

    def test_selected_reviewer_and_three_party_messages(self):
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.change_share("other",self.share["id"],"approve")
        self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        snapshot=self.store.snapshot("test")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["instances"][0]["state"],"approved")
        for kind in ["review_result","shared"]:
            self.assertEqual(sorted(message["user_id"] for message in snapshot["messages"] if message["kind"]==kind),["owner","recipient","reviewer"])
        self.assertEqual(self.service.download("recipient",self.file["id"])[1],b"Private synthetic content")

    def test_pending_and_rejected_have_no_recipient_access(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.service.dashboard("recipient")["received"],[])
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.download("recipient",self.file["id"])
        self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"reject")
        self.assertEqual(self.service.dashboard("recipient")["received"],[])
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.download("recipient",self.file["id"])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.store.snapshot("test")["messages"]),3)

    def test_cancel_blocks_late_approval(self):
        self.service.change_share("owner",self.share["id"],"cancel")
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        self.assertEqual(self.state(),"cancelled")
        self.assertEqual(self.store.snapshot("test")["messages"],[])

    def test_nonowner_cannot_cancel_or_revoke(self):
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.change_share("other",self.share["id"],"cancel")
        self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.change_share("recipient",self.share["id"],"revoke")
        self.assertEqual(self.state(),"approved")

    def test_stale_browser_download_after_revocation(self):
        self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        application=create_app(self.service)
        client=application.test_client()
        with client.session_transaction() as session:
            session["user"]={"id":"recipient","name":"Xu"}
        old_page=client.get("/")
        url="/download/"+self.file["id"]
        self.assertIn(url.encode(),old_page.data)
        downloaded=client.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(downloaded.status_code,200)
        self.service.change_share("owner",self.share["id"],"revoke")
        self.assertEqual(client.get(url).status_code,403)
        self.assertEqual(downloaded.data,b"Private synthetic content")
        self.assertEqual(self.service.dashboard("recipient")["received"],[])

    def test_notification_is_private(self):
        self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        message=self.service.dashboard("recipient")["messages"][0]
        with self.assertRaises(BusinessError):
            self.service.read_notification("other",message["id"])
        self.service.read_notification("recipient",message["id"])
        self.assertEqual(next(row for row in self.service.dashboard("recipient")["messages"] if row["id"]==message["id"])["is_read"],1)

    def test_failed_message_write_rolls_back_state_and_all_messages(self):
        original=self.service._messages
        def fail_after_insert(*args):
            original(*args)
            raise OSError("synthetic transaction failure")
        with patch.object(self.service,"_messages",fail_after_insert):
            with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                self.service.change_share("reviewer",self.share["id"],"approve")
        snapshot=self.store.snapshot("test")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["instances"][0]["state"],"pending")
        self.assertEqual(snapshot["messages"],[])
        self.assertEqual(len(snapshot["instances"][0]["journal"]),1)

    def test_cancel_approve_race_has_one_authoritative_result(self):
        barrier=threading.Barrier(2)
        results=[]
        def act(actor,event):
            barrier.wait()
            try:
                results.append(self.service.change_share(actor,self.share["id"],event)["state"])
            except BusinessError:
                results.append("denied")
        threads=[threading.Thread(target=act,args=("owner","cancel")),threading.Thread(target=act,args=("reviewer","approve"))]
        for thread in threads:thread.start()
        for thread in threads:thread.join(5)
        self.assertEqual(len(results),2)
        self.assertEqual(results.count("denied"),1)
        self.assertIn(self.state(),{"approved","cancelled"})
        self.assertEqual(len(self.store.snapshot("test")["messages"]),6 if self.state()=="approved" else 0)

    def test_http_csrf_and_anonymous_download(self):
        application=create_app(self.service)
        client=application.test_client()
        client.get("/")
        client.post("/",data={"action":"login","username":"owner","password":"TrialOnly!2026","csrf":"incorrect"})
        with client.session_transaction() as session:
            self.assertNotIn("user",session)
        self.assertEqual(client.get("/download/"+self.file["id"]).status_code,401)

    def test_native_executor_rejects_unsupported_semantics(self):
        invalid=deepcopy(self.project["model"]["machine"])
        invalid["queued"]=True
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            BOExecutor(invalid,{"authorized":lambda context,payload:True})

    def test_real_schema_change_is_detected_without_mutating_application_schema(self):
        import os
        os.environ["TEST_TRIAL_DB"]="sqlite:///"+self.store.database.as_posix()
        config={"id":"application","engine":"sqlalchemy","url_env":"TEST_TRIAL_DB"}
        before=collect(config,root=ROOT)
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.store.database)) as connection:
            connection.execute("ALTER TABLE shares ADD COLUMN review_note TEXT")
            connection.commit()
        after=collect(config,root=ROOT)
        self.assertNotEqual(before,after)
        share_table=next(table for table in after["resources"] if table["key"]=="table:shares")
        self.assertIn("review_note",[field["name"] for field in share_table["fields"]])


if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()

def main():
    os.environ["TRIAL_DATABASE_URL"]="sqlite:///"+(ROOT/"data/application.sqlite3").as_posix()
    project=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    session=GraphSession(ROOT)
    graph_server=make_server(session,port=0)
    graph_url="http://127.0.0.1:"+str(graph_server.server_port)+"/graph"
    def sink(body,kind):
        if kind=="events":
            session.event(body)
        else:
            session.snapshot(body)
    monitor=BOMonitor(project,session.manifest["build_id"],sink=sink)
    store=Store(ROOT/"data",monitor)
    store.initialize()
    service=Service(store,project,ROOT)
    application=create_app(service,graph_url,session.manifest["build_id"])
    application_server=make_application_server("127.0.0.1",0,application,threaded=True)

    print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
    threading.Thread(target=graph_server.serve_forever,daemon=True,name="trial-graph-http").start()
    try:

    finally:
        graph_server.shutdown()
        graph_server.server_close()
        application_server.server_close()
        monitor.probe.close()
        store.engine.dispose()


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()

    if case in {"cancelled","owner_cancels_pending","cancelled_request_review_denied","cancelled_file_hidden"}:
        return "cancelled"
    if case in {"revoked","owner_revokes_share","revoked_old_url_denied","revoked_stale_page_denied","revoked_file_hidden"}:
        return "revoked"
    if case in {"pending","unauthorized","unselected_reviewer_denied","ungranted_download_denied","pending_download_denied","pending_file_hidden","nonowner_cancel_denied"}:
        return "pending"
    return "approved"


def run_case(case,mode,project,build_id,directory):
    events=[]
    snapshots=[]
    def sink(body,kind):
        if mode=="fault":
            raise OSError("deliberate observation failure")
        (events if kind=="events" else snapshots).append(body)
    monitor=BOMonitor(project,build_id,sink=sink,enabled=mode!="off",run_id=case+"-"+mode)
    store=Store(directory,monitor)
    store.initialize()
    service=Service(store,project,ROOT)
    service.login("owner","TrialOnly!2026")
    if case=="invalid_login":
        expect_denied(lambda:service.login("owner","wrong-test-password"))
    file=service.upload("owner","trial-notes.txt",b"Synthetic trial file.\n")
    share=service.request_share("owner",file["id"],"recipient","reviewer")
    if case=="upload_anonymous_denied":
        expect_denied(lambda:service.upload("","denied.txt",b"denied"))
    if case=="nonowner_share_denied":
        expect_denied(lambda:service.request_share("other",file["id"],"recipient","reviewer"))
    if case in {"unauthorized","unselected_reviewer_denied"}:
        expect_denied(lambda:service.change_share("other",share["id"],"approve"))
    if case=="nonowner_cancel_denied":
        expect_denied(lambda:service.change_share("other",share["id"],"cancel"))
    state=outcome_for(case)
    if state in {"approved","revoked"}:
        service.change_share("reviewer",share["id"],"approve")
    elif state=="rejected":
        service.change_share("reviewer",share["id"],"reject")
    elif state=="cancelled":
        service.change_share("owner",share["id"],"cancel")
        if case=="cancelled_request_review_denied":
            expect_denied(lambda:service.change_share("reviewer",share["id"],"approve"))
    if case=="nonowner_revoke_denied":
        expect_denied(lambda:service.change_share("other",share["id"],"revoke"))
    if state=="revoked":
        assert service.download("recipient",file["id"])[1]==b"Synthetic trial file.\n"
        service.change_share("owner",share["id"],"revoke")
    if state=="approved":
        filename,body=service.download("recipient",file["id"])
        assert filename=="trial-notes.txt" and body==b"Synthetic trial file.\n"
        allowed=True
    else:
        assert expect_denied(lambda:service.download("recipient",file["id"]))==403
        allowed=False
    dashboard=service.dashboard("recipient")
    if state=="approved":
        message=dashboard["messages"][0]
        service.read_notification("recipient",message["id"])
    assert bool(dashboard["received"])==(state=="approved")
    application=create_app(service)
    client=application.test_client()
    client.get("/")
    with client.session_transaction() as session:
        csrf=session["csrf"]
    client.post("/",data={"action":"login","username":"recipient","password":"TrialOnly!2026","csrf":csrf})
    assert client.get("/").status_code==200
    response=client.get("/download/"+file["id"])
    assert response.status_code==(200 if state=="approved" else 403)
    with client.session_transaction() as session:
        csrf=session["csrf"]
    client.post("/",data={"action":"logout","csrf":csrf})
    service.logout("owner")
    monitor.flush()
    authority=store.snapshot(build_id)
    row=authority["instances"][0]
    messages=authority["messages"]
    observations={"state":row["state"],"download_allowed":allowed,"recipient_visible":bool(dashboard["received"]),"review_results":sum(item["kind"]=="review_result" for item in messages),"share_messages":sum(item["kind"]=="shared" for item in messages),"file_size":len(b"Synthetic trial file.\n"),"recipient_id":"recipient"}
    machine=machine_from(authority)
    graph=BOStateGraph(project["model"],build_id=build_id,mode="drive")
    projection={"build_id":build_id,"machine":machine,"instances":graph.bo_instances(machine)}
    run={"case":case,"mode":mode,"events":events,"snapshots":snapshots,"observations":observations,"authority_snapshot":authority,"projection":projection,"policy_evaluations":monitor.evaluations,"mapping_checks":[{"id":"state-"+case,"source":"Independent SQLite Store.snapshot","projection":["state"],"actual":row["state"],"mapped":projection["instances"][0]["observed"]["state"]}],"probe_health":{"errors":monitor.probe.bo_errors,"dropped":monitor.probe.bo_dropped,"data_errors":monitor.data.bo_errors},"loaded_definition":service.machine}
    monitor.probe.close()
    store.engine.dispose()
    return run


def main():
    os.environ["TRIAL_DATABASE_URL"]="sqlite:///"+(ROOT/"data/application.sqlite3").as_posix()
    project=json.loads((ROOT/"bo_stategraph/project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifest=capture(ROOT,project["model"])
    contract=json.loads((ROOT/"mapping.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    output={"build_id":manifest["build_id"],"machine":project["model"]["machine"],"runs":[]}
    for case in contract["cases"]:
        for mode in contract["modes"]:
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="case-",dir=ROOT/"review") as directory:
                run=run_case(case,mode,project,manifest["build_id"],directory)
                output["runs"].append(run)
    selected=next(run for run in output["runs"] if run["case"]=="approved" and run["mode"]=="on")
    graph=BOStateGraph(project["model"],build_id=manifest["build_id"],mode="drive")
    output["stategraph_export"]=graph.bo_export(runtime={"machine":selected["projection"]["machine"]})
    target=ROOT/"review/runtime-observations.json"
    target.write_text(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
